subject: Re: Encord Intro Chat - Annotation and QA
text:
Hi Callum,

No problem at all. Tomorrow, Tuesday 28th, at 11:00am works well for me.
Please feel free to send over the updated calendar invitation.

I’m also resending the background information below, just in case my
previous email was affected by the recent issue we identified with some of
our messages landing in spam folders.

We are a medical AI startup that has recently closed its seed funding
round. We have partnered with several NHS Trusts and US hospitals and are
preparing to label paediatric X-ray data for fracture detection and
classification.

Our initial requirement is approximately 10,000 X-ray studies, which we
would ideally like to complete within three months. We expect additional
datasets to become available asynchronously as each hospital completes its
respective data-access and governance processes.

The main areas we would like to understand are:

   - Whether Encord can provide access to specialist paediatric
   radiologists or clinicians with relevant paediatric fracture experience.
   - The ability to receive and securely manage raw DICOM images, while
   generating consistent review images and preserving the original metadata,
   spatial information and frame of reference.
   - Fast and secure remote access for our own clinicians to participate in
   review and adjudication.
   - Support for two independent reviewers, followed by adjudication where
   there is disagreement.
   - Secure data-transfer methods and available deployment or hosting
   options.
   - The annotation platform and workflow, including QA processes, audit
   trails and reviewer-performance monitoring.
   - Pricing, ideally expressed as a cost per image or study reviewed
   rather than solely as an hourly rate.

The anticipated labelling tasks include:

   - Fracture-positive or fracture-negative classification.
   - A bounding box or region of interest around each fracture.
   - Identification of the bone involved.
   - Classification of the formal fracture type or morpho

Users/Seats

queried/curated?

embeddings can be generated via off-the-shelf or custom models?

package, or priced separately?

subject: Exploring a Data Collection Partnership with Encord
text:
Dear William,

I hope you are doing well.

I wanted to introduce Jupiter AI Labs and explore opportunities to support Encord's growing initiatives in multimodal AI, computer vision, robotics, Physical AI, Vision-Language-Action (VLA), and large-scale AI data operations.

At Jupiter AI Labs, we specialize in designing and scaling end-to-end AI data collection and managed data operations—from workforce sourcing and hardware deployment to large-scale data collection, quality assurance, metadata generation, and secure cloud delivery. We partner with AI labs, robotics companies, and enterprise organizations to deliver high-quality datasets that accelerate the development of next-generation AI models.

Our capabilities include:

• 

Physical AI & Embodied AI Data Collection

• 

Egocentric, Multi-Camera & Stereo Video Capture

• 

RGB-D, LiDAR, IMU & Sensor Fusion Data Collection

• 

Teleoperation & Human Demonstration Data

• 

Robotics, Vision Foundation Model & VLA Training Data

• 

Warehouse, Retail, Industrial & Real-World Environment Data Collection

• 

Multimodal AI Data Collection & Annotation

• 

AI Data Operations, Quality Assurance & Managed Workforce Solutions

• 

Generative AI, LLM Evaluation & Human Feedback (RLHF)

• 

Cloud, Data Engineering & Enterprise AI Solutions

In addition to data collection, we provide scalable global deployment capabilities. India serves as our primary operational hub, where we maintain a large pool of trained data collectors, ready-to-deploy GoPro hardware, and extensive experience collecting data across commercial, residential, retail, warehouse, and industrial environments.

Beyond India, we support data collection across the USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Africa, LATAM, and more than 30 additional countries through our network of vetted contributors and local partners. We can rapidly recruit and onboard project-specific contributors while maintaining standardized SOPs, rigorous QA proces
